explication: RealisticLivestock is a Farming Simulator 25 mod that replaces template/cluster livestock with individually identified animals and adds simulation, husbandry production, dealer, and animal-screen features. The documented user workflow is to acquire animals through the overhauled dealer, manage and observe them in husbandries, and review their individual details in the UI. The source tree supports mapping these capabilities to runtime modules, but no source excerpts were provided, so relationships below rely only on README statements.
